title: The Ory band's instruments: drum set-up, valve trombone, first slide
summary: Joseph and Allen discuss the dead drummer, bass drum with crowfoot pedal and side cymbal, homemade traps and hitting the rim instead of wood blocks. Ory's trombone was a valve trombone; Henry Sawyer was the first man Joseph saw with a slide.
